notes.title: New DEMO Live! - Latin America Games Showcase
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43759403/3bdacf570e804cc37d81e75f98200723a6096c2a.png[/img]


We are excited to announce the new DEMO for The Last Grape!
During the LAGS event, Steam users will be able to download our new version of the DEMO.

We have been developing this game for a long time and it is very important to us to hear your feedback!

Add The Last Grape to your wishlist and follow Burning Goat on social media to keep up with our work!

notes.title: First look at the DEMO
notes.notes:
This week at the Pirates x Ninjas, you can play the first stage of The Last Grape!

The DEMO will be available for download till the end of the event so be ready to slice some vegetables!
